WRITTEN TERMS • TRUST
Warranty & Guarantee — Clearly Separate
Final applicability is controlled by the written invoice/job card/warranty card for the specific work.


⚙️ ENGINE WORK — 1 YEAR*
Eligible complete engine overhaul/rebuild work, subject to written terms and exclusions.


MANDATORY FIRST SERVICE
500–750 km OR 15–30 days, whichever comes first.
NEXT SERVICE
1,800–2,000 km OR 45–60 days, whichever comes first.


🛡️ GENERAL SERVICE — 30 DAYS*
Separate workmanship guarantee for eligible workmanship during complete general service.
📋 WRITTEN RECORD
Coverage, dates, job scope and exclusions should be written on the final invoice/job card/warranty card.
🚫 NOT A BLANKET WARRANTY
Running/wear parts, unrelated faults and excluded conditions are not automatically covered.


📁 Customer Record & Warranty Tracking
Keep the final invoice, job card and written warranty card with the booking reference. Record the customer name/mobile, vehicle brand/model, registration, complaint, inspection findings, approved estimate, parts fitted, delivery date, warranty start/end date and follow-up service due date. Customer booking history is retrieved from the central booking database when the customer verifies their mobile number. The official record remains the workshop database, invoice and job card.
Note for management: the HTML submits booking data to its configured booking-service endpoint, but Google Sheet row creation and email delivery must be tested from the live backend before being treated as verified.


⚠️ Outside repair/opening/check-up/intervention
⚠️ Running parts & normal wear
⚠️ Accident/misuse/overheating/abnormal use
⚠️ Routine maintenance/unrelated faults
⚠️ Missed mandatory service schedule
⚠️ Manufacturer/part defects under applicable manufacturer/part warranty
